opening.argument: The video connects BitConnect directly to profits and daily income from home, then gives specific returns for lending and staking: “when you loan them out you have 1% and if you stake them you get, well 10% to the end of this month or 8% for the next 6 months.” The displayed pages reinforce that pitch with lending amounts, daily interest, capital-release periods, and a control to proceed with an investment. The speaker also discusses putting money into another loan, including a possible $1,000 loan and about one percent. Although he says it is not financial advice and describes trading as risky, those qualifications do not erase the video’s concrete presentation of income and percentage returns tied to lending or staking.
